scope: All 152 currently listed screening round-5 candidates (102 Storm, 50 Hurricane), plus five previously listed round-4 IDs retained for audit history; 157 distinct IDs total.
prediction_source: Current predictions are from research-results-61/results/screen_round5.json, source commit 57434fb. Hurricane remains H4.0 with the repaired five-member ensemble; these are not H6 model scores. First-audit round-4 values are separately retained.

summary.interpretation: Two literature reports describe limited-condition nonsuperconductivity. All other intrinsic superconductivity outcomes remain unknown. No search can establish that nobody has ever measured a material.

method: Every candidate received actual formula/alternative-order searches, with promising primary or author/institutional copies opened when available. Access failures, wrong phases, mixtures and different stoichiometries are recorded. Absence of a located report remains unknown. Structural references and magnetic order do not establish a superconductivity negative.
